data.title: 爱夏·页边的术式修订
data.action: 左手食指对照书中图形，右手在笔记页边补上一笔
data.description: 爱夏侧坐在藏书室长桌旁，左手食指按着参考书中的术式图，右手在旁边的笔记页上补画一条连线。她微微前倾，视线落在笔尖；高领衬衫和绿色马甲清晰可辨。斜射午后日光横过两本打开的书，墨水瓶放在远离袖口的桌角，背景仅保留拱窗和书脊。
data.promptProse: Two open volumes lie side side on the library table: a reference tome and a working notebook. Aisha leans slightly forward, placing her left index finger beneath a diagram in the tome while her right hand draws one connecting stroke in the notebook with a feather pen. A three-quarter view keeps her intent eyes and both contact points visible. Afternoon sun crosses the pages diagonally, with an inkpot at the far corner and the arch of a tall window behind her shoulder.
